svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, mirror images. Cut 160 mm lengths of 20 x 5 mm bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle slot at one end: 10.0 mm wide (a snug fit on the motor's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm axle flats), open at the end, 23.4 mm deep, round-ended;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the axle centre sits 15 mm in from the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw the sides, then file to a 10 mm gauge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Joggle: two bends, 12 and 28 mm from the axle centre, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long part sits 8 mm further out than the slotted end. Bend

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in a vice over a 5 mm packing, one arm left-hand, one right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round and deburr both ends; paint or zinc spray.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the slotted end lies flat on the outside of the dropout,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the axle washer and nut; the long part lies on the outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the fork blade, held 130 mm up by a band clamp.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no shake on the axle flats; the long part touches the blade.
